title: God's Epic Comeback for His People
paragraphs: Wake up! Wake up, Zion! Get dressed in your best clothes, Jerusalem, you're the holy city! All the haters who aren't about God have been kicked out. They're not part of this journey. So get up, brush off the dust, captive Jerusalem! Break free from your chains, daughter of Zion!
God is saying, "You were sold for like, nothing. So I'm buying you back for nothing."

The Master, God, also says, "A long time ago, my people went to Egypt and were basically strangers there. Then Assyria came and bullied them. And now, what's this?" This is God's official decree. "My people are getting dragged off again for no good reason. These tyrants are just running around, celebrating, while my name gets dragged through the mud 24/7. But it's time for my people to know who I am, what I'm really about—and yeah, that I have something to say. And here I am!"

How awesome is it to see the messenger's feet on the mountains, bringing the good news, telling everyone that it's all good, that good times are coming, announcing salvation, and telling Zion, "Your God is in charge!" Listen! Your lookouts are shouting, like a massive thunderclap, all in sync. They're literally seeing with their own eyes God returning to Zion. So break out in song! Even the ruins of Jerusalem should be booming, "God has comforted his people! He's redeemed Jerusalem!" God has rolled up his sleeves, and all the nations can see his holy, muscled arm. Everyone, from one end of the earth to the other, is seeing him do his thing, his salvation work.

Get out of there! Seriously, leave that place! Don't look back. Don't get contaminated by grabbing their stuff. Just go, but go clean. You gotta stay pure while you worship, carrying God's holy things. But for real, you don't have to sprint. You're not running away from anyone! God is leading you out, and the God of Israel is your rear guard, watching your back.

"Just watch my servant, he's about to have a major glow-up! He'll be exalted, standing tall, head and shoulders above everyone. But it wasn't always like this. At first, everyone was shook. He didn't even look human—his face was so messed up, you couldn't even recognize him. But now, nations all over the world will be in awe, totally speechless when they see him. Kings will be shocked into silence. Because what they've never heard of, they'll see with their own eyes. What was once unthinkable will be right in front of them."

title: He Took the Hit for Us
paragraphs: Seriously, who would've believed what we saw? Like, who would have guessed God's rescue plan would look like this?

This servant grew up in God's eyes like a weak little plant in a super dry field. There was nothing about him that made you look twice. He was totally overlooked and ignored, a guy who was always suffering and knew pain up close. People would literally turn away when they saw him. We all looked down on him, thought he was a total nobody. But the truth is, he was carrying our pain—all our brokenness and all the stuff wrong with us. We thought God was punishing him for his own screw-ups. But it was our sins that messed him up, that tore him apart and crushed him. Our sins! He took the punishment that made us whole. His bruises are what healed us. We're all like sheep who've wandered off and gotten lost. We've all gone our own way, done our own thing. And God put all our sins, everything we've ever done wrong, on him.

He was beaten and tortured, but he didn't say a word. Like a lamb being led to the slaughter or a sheep getting sheared, he just took it all in silence. Justice was a joke, and he was led away—and did anyone even get what was really going on? He died without even thinking about himself, beaten to a pulp for the sins of my people. They buried him with criminals, threw him in a rich guy's tomb, even though he'd never hurt anyone or said a single lie.

But this was God's plan all along, to crush him with pain. The deal was that he'd offer himself for our sins, and then he'd see new life come from it—tons and tons of life. And God's plan will totally succeed because of him.

After all that terrible suffering, he'll see that it was all worth it and be glad he did it. Through everything he went through, my righteous servant will make a lot of people right with God, because he's carrying the weight of their sins. That's why I'm going to give him the highest honor and the best of everything. Because he faced death and didn't even flinch, and he hung out with the lowest of the low. He took on the sins of everyone and stood up for all the outcasts.

title: God's Epic Comeback Plan for You
paragraphs: Sing out, even if you feel totally left out and like you've got nothing, it's time to celebrate! Start singing, even if you've never had a reason to before. God's saying you're about to have more blessings than you can even handle, way more than the people who seem to have it all. So get ready! Make space for all the good stuff coming your way. Think bigger! You're gonna need way more room for your crew 'cause it's about to get huge. You're gonna be so influential, taking over places and rebuilding what was broken. Don't even stress, you're not gonna be embarrassed. Don't hold back, you won't fail. You'll forget all the cringey stuff from when you were younger, and the pain of being alone will just fade away. Because the one who made you? He's your husband, and his name is God, the commander of all the angel armies! The one who saves you is the Holy One of Israel, and he's the God of the whole world. You felt like you were abandoned, totally heartbroken, but God's welcoming you back with open arms. Like someone who got married young and then got left, but now you're wanted back," says your God.

Your Redeemer God says: "I had to leave for a sec, but it was just for a moment. Now, I'm coming back with so much love and compassion. I was really mad for a second and had to turn away, but that's over now. I'm here for you with a love that's not going anywhere.

"This whole situation is like Noah's flood all over again. Back then, I promised that I'd never flood the whole world again. And now, I'm promising that I'm not gonna be angry or call you out anymore. Even if the mountains literally get up and walk away, and the hills crumble, my love for you is staying put. My promise of peace is solid." The God who has your back is saying this, for real.

"To the city that's been through it, beat down by storms and feeling forgotten: I'm about to give you a major glow-up. I'm rebuilding you with turquoise stones, your foundations with sapphires, your towers with rubies, your gates with jewels, and all your walls with precious stones. All your kids will be taught by God himself—what a mentor! You'll be built strong, on a foundation of what's right. You'll be safe from any trouble—nothing to be scared of! No terror will even get close. If anyone tries to fight you, don't think for a second that I sent them. And if they do attack, it's not gonna work. I'm the one who created the blacksmith who makes weapons, and I'm also the one who created the destroyer. But no weapon that could hurt you has ever been made. Anyone who tries to call you out in court will be exposed as a liar. This is the inheritance for God's crew. I'll make sure everything works out for you in the end." That's a decree from God himself.

title: God's Free Upgrade is Legit
paragraphs: "Hey, anyone who’s thirsty, come get some water! You broke? No worries, come on and get some food! Seriously, get your drinks, wine, milk—it's all on the house, no money needed! Why are you wasting your cash on junk food and stuff that doesn't even last? Just listen up, for real: eat the good stuff, the best stuff. Pay attention, come here, and listen to what I'm saying, 'cause these words will give you life. I'm making a promise to you that'll last forever, the same kind of solid, real love I showed David. I made him a big deal, a leader for all the nations, and now it's your turn. You're gonna call over nations you don't even know, and they'll come running to you because of me, your God, 'cause the Holy One of Israel thinks you're awesome."

"Look for God while He's around, pray to Him while He's close. If you're doing bad stuff, just stop. If you're thinking bad thoughts, change your mind. Come back to God, 'cause He's super merciful. Come back to our God, 'cause He's always ready to forgive."

"My thoughts are not like your thoughts. The way I do things is not how you do things," says God. "Just like the sky is way, way higher than the earth, my ways are way beyond your ways, and my thoughts are way beyond your thoughts. Think about it—rain and snow come down from the sky and don't go back up until they've watered the ground, making plants grow and giving seeds to farmers and food to everyone. That's how it is with my words. They won't come back to me without doing something. They'll do exactly what I sent them to do, and they'll get the job done."

"So you're gonna go out full of joy, and you'll be led to a life that's totally complete. The mountains and hills will be cheering you on, like they're singing. All the trees will be clapping for you. Instead of prickly weeds, you'll have huge, amazing trees. Instead of thorny bushes, you'll have tall, strong pines. These will be like a huge sign for me, for God, a living, breathing reminder of me that will last forever."

title: God's Open Invite is Lowkey GOATED
paragraphs: God's message is this: "Guard what's right. Look out for each other. Do the right thing, and do it for the right reasons, 'cause my rescue mission is about to drop. You're super blessed if you're in on this, if you're all about it. That means respecting the Sabbath, not messing it up, and just, like, not doing messed-up stuff. And for real, don't ever let anyone who's not from around here but is trying to follow God feel like they're second-rate, like they don't belong. And anyone who's been through some physical stuff, don't let them think they're 'damaged goods' and can't be part of this.'

For God says: 'To those who've been through it physically but still keep my Sabbaths, choose what I'm about, and hold on tight to my promises, I'm gonna give you a place of honor in my family and my city. Like, even more honor than my own sons and daughters. I'm talking permanent honored status that never gets canceled.'

'And for all the outsiders who are now rolling with me, serving me, loving my name, and wanting to be my crew—everyone who respects the Sabbath and holds on to my promises—I'm gonna bring you to my holy mountain and make you joyful in my house of prayer. You're totally welcome to worship just like the insiders, bringing your own offerings to my altar. Oh yeah, my house of worship will be known as a house of prayer for everyone.' This is the official word from the Master, God himself, who's gathering all the scattered people of Israel: 'I'm gonna gather even more people, bringing them in with the ones who are already here.'

A call to the wild animals: Come get 'em. Come on, you savage beasts, and devour! 'Cause Israel's lookouts are totally blind, the whole squad. They have no clue what's happening. They're like guard dogs that don't even know how to bark, just lazy dogs dreaming in the sun. But man, they're hungry dogs, they know how to eat. Super greedy dogs who are never satisfied. And these are supposed to be Israel's shepherds! They know nothing, understand nothing. They're all just looking out for themselves, taking whatever they can get. 'Come on,' they say, 'let's party. Let's go get wasted!' And tomorrow will be just the same: 'Let's live it up!'

title: God's REAL Talk vs. Fake Religion
paragraphs: Meanwhile, good people are dying and literally no one cares. God-fearing people get taken away, and it's like nobody even notices. The thing is, these good people are finally out of their misery and at peace. They lived good, dignified lives, and now they're finally resting.

But you guys... children of a witch, for real... come over here. You sons of a shameless woman, daughters of an unfaithful one. What gives you the right to be mocking people, sneering, and sticking your tongue out? Do you even get how messed up you've become? A whole generation of rebels and liars. You're out there satisfying your desires wherever you find a bit of shade, doing whatever you want. You're sacrificing your own kids in any random spot—any cave or crack in the rock is good enough for you. You grab stones from the creek to set up your weird sex-and-religion shrines. You've basically chosen your own downfall. Your so-called 'worship' is gonna be what ruins you. You've climbed up high mountains to do your gross sex-and-death rituals. Behind closed doors, you've got your collection of precious little gods and goddesses. You've totally abandoned me, gone all out, stripped down, and made your bed a place of worship. You've hopped into bed with so-called 'sacred' prostitutes and loved every second of it, obsessing over their naked bodies. You pour fancy oils on your king-god and load up on perfumes for yourselves. You send people out to find the newest religious trend, sending them all the way to hell and back. You completely wear yourselves out trying every new and different thing, and you never realize what a total waste it is. You always seem to find the energy for the latest fad, never getting tired of trying out new religions.

Who even convinced you to chase after all this nonsense, leaving me completely forgotten, like you never even knew me? Just because I don't scream and cause a scene, you think I don't exist? I'm going to lay out, piece by piece, all your so-called 'righteous' attempts at religion and show you how ridiculous it all is. Go on, cry out to your collection of fake gods for help. A little puff of wind will blow them all away. They're just smoke, absolutely nothing. But anyone who runs to me for help will get the land as their own; they'll end up owning my holy mountain!
Someone's saying: 'Build it, build it! Make a road! Clear the path, get the rocks out of the way for my people to travel.'

A message from the God who is high and mighty, who lives forever, whose name is Holy: 'I live in the highest and holiest places, but I'm also right there with those who are feeling low and crushed. And what I do is breathe new life into them, get them back up on their feet. Because I'm not going to drag people into court forever; I'm not going to stay angry for all time. If I did, people would just lose hope. The very souls I created would get exhausted and give up. I was angry, really angry, because of Israel's sins. I hit him hard and turned away in my anger, but he just kept on being stubborn and doing his own thing. When I looked again and saw what he was up to, I decided to heal him, lead him, and comfort him, creating a new way for the mourners to praise. Peace to those far away, and peace to those who are near,' says God—'and yes, I will heal them. But the wicked are like a stormy sea that can't calm down. Its waves just churn up garbage and mud. There is no peace,' God says, 'for the wicked.'

title: God's Real Fast vs. Your Fake One
paragraphs: "Shout it out! Don't hold back, make it loud like a trumpet blast! Tell my people what they're doing wrong, confront my family, Jacob, with their sins. They're always busy with worship and love learning about me. They look like a nation of good people, following the law and honoring God. They ask me, ‘What’s the right thing to do?’ and love having me on their side. But they also complain, ‘Why do we fast and you don’t see it? Why do we humble ourselves and you don’t even notice?’

"Well, here’s the deal: “The main point of your ‘fast days’ is to make a profit. You push your workers way too hard. You fast, but at the same time you're arguing and fighting. You fast, but you're ready to throw punches. The way you're fasting won't even get your prayers heard. Do you think this is the kind of fast I want: a day to show off how humble you are? To put on a serious face and walk around in black like you're so holy? You call that fasting, a fast day that I, God, would actually like?

“This is the kind of fast day I'm looking for: to break the chains of injustice, stop exploiting workers, free the oppressed, and cancel debts. What I want to see you do is: share your food with the hungry, invite the homeless poor into your homes, give clothes to those who are cold and have nothing, and be there for your own families. If you do this, things will get bright for you, and your life will turn around in an instant. Your good deeds will lead the way for you. The glory of God will protect you. Then when you pray, God will answer. You’ll call for help and I’ll say, ‘Here I am.’

“If you stop being unfair, stop blaming the victims, and stop gossiping about other people's sins, if you're generous to the hungry and help those who are down, your life will start to shine in the darkness, and your darkest moments will become bright as the sun. I will always guide you. I’ll give you a full life even in the driest places—you'll be strong and healthy. You’ll be like a garden that's always watered, a spring that never runs out of water. You’ll use the ruins of your past to build something new, and rebuild on the old foundations. You’ll be known as the people who can fix anything, restore old ruins, rebuild and renovate, and make the community a great place to live again.

“If you're careful on the Sabbath and don’t use my holy day for your own benefit, if you treat the Sabbath as a day of joy, God’s holy day as a celebration, if you honor it by not doing your usual business, not making money, not running around—then you’ll be able to truly enjoy God! Oh, I’ll make you soar high above everything. I’ll let you enjoy the inheritance of your ancestor Jacob.” Yes! God himself said so!

title: God's Epic Rescue Mission
paragraphs: Look! Listen! God isn’t weak. He can totally still save you. And He's not ignoring you; He can still hear. The issue isn't God, it's you. Your messed-up choices created this huge gap between you and God. Your sins are basically blocking His reception so He can't hear you. Your hands are literally covered in blood, your fingers are dripping with guilt. You're constantly lying, and your tongue is always muttering messed-up stuff. Nobody stands up for what's right, and no one plays fair. You all trust in empty illusions, you tell lies, you cook up trouble and end up with more sin. It's like you're hatching snake eggs and weaving spider webs. Eat one of those eggs and you die; crack one open and a snake pops out. Those spider webs are useless for making clothes. You can't wear that stuff! All you do is weave wickedness and hatch violence. You're all racing to do evil, trying to be the first to murder someone. You plan and breathe evil, leaving a trail of wrecked lives behind you. You know nothing about peace and even less about justice. The paths you're on are all twisted and jacked up. There's no peace for anyone who walks down those roads.

So basically, we're super far from being fair, and we're not even close to living right. We're desperate for light but we just keep falling into darkness. We want things to be bright, but we're just stumbling through the night. We're like blind people, inching along a wall, groping around without a clue. We're shuffling around in broad daylight like we're dead but somehow still walking. We're no better than bears groaning and no worse than doves moaning. We're looking for justice, but there's zero sign of it. We're looking for salvation, but there's not even a hint.

Our screw-ups are piled up right in front of you, God, and our sins are calling us out. Our wrongdoings are staring us in the face; we know exactly what we've done: dissing and denying God, not following our God, spreading lies, starting drama, being full of lies, and whispering malicious things. Justice gets shut down, and righteousness is kicked to the curb. Truth is tripping up in the streets, and honesty is nowhere to be found. Goodness is MIA. Anyone who tries to stop doing evil just gets beat up and robbed.

God looked and saw all this evil on the horizon—so much evil and not a single sign of justice. He was shocked by what He saw: not one person was around to fix this awful situation. So He did it Himself. He took on the job of Salvation, powered by His own Righteousness. He put on Righteousness like a suit of armor, with Salvation as His helmet. He wore Judgment like a coat and threw a cloak of Passion over His shoulders. He's going to make everyone pay for what they've done: fury for His haters, and payback for His enemies. Even the faraway islands will get what they deserve. In the west, they'll respect God's name, and in the east, they'll respect His glory. Because He'll show up like a flash flood, whipped into a raging torrent by the wind of God.
'I'll show up in Zion as the Redeemer, for all the people of Jacob who turn away from their sins.' That's God's decree.

'As for me,' God says, 'this is my promise to them: My Spirit that I've put on you and the words that I've given you to speak, they're not going to leave your mouths, or your children's mouths, or your grandchildren's mouths. You will keep repeating these words and will never stop.' Those are God's orders.

title: Jerusalem's Epic Glow Up is GOATED
paragraphs: Jerusalem, get out of bed! Time to wake up and catch some rays. God's glory is seriously shining on you. The rest of the world is in total darkness, but God's light is hitting you like a sunrise. Nations are gonna flock to your light, and kings will be drawn to your brightness. Just look up and look around! Watch everyone gathering and coming to you: your sons from miles away, and your daughters getting a ride from their nannies. Seeing them will make you smile so big, your heart will feel like it's gonna burst. All your people are coming home from overseas for a huge reunion, a massive harvest of exiles from all over. And you'll see endless camel caravans, young camels from Midian and Ephah, rolling in from Sheba with tons of gold and frankincense, telling everyone how great God is. Plus, a ton of flocks from Kedar and Nebaioth will be brought as offerings to my altar, making my beautiful Sanctuary even more glorious.

“What's that in the distance? A cloud on the horizon, like a huge flock of doves? It's a fleet of ships from faraway islands, the legendary Tarshish ships, bringing your kids home from all over. They're loaded with silver and gold, all in the name of your God, the Holy One of Israel, who's making you look absolutely splendid. Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will help you out with your worship. I was mad and I hit you hard, but now I want to be good to you. Your city gates will always be open, 24/7, with wealth pouring in from every nation, and their kings will be like your delivery guys. Any nation that doesn't get on board will be totally wrecked. The best wood from Lebanon—cypress, oak, and pine—will be brought to make my Sanctuary look incredible, making the place where I rest my feet glorious. The kids of the people who bullied you will come and bow down to you. Everyone who ever dissed you will be kissing your feet. They'll call you 'City of God,' 'Zion of the Holy One of Israel.' Not long ago, you were hated and ignored, a total ghost town. But now, I've made you famous and awesome forever, a place that brings joy to everyone. You'll be nourished by nations and royalty, and you'll know for sure that I, God, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Champion of Jacob. I'm giving you a major upgrade—no more hand-me-downs! Gold instead of bronze, silver instead of iron, bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. I'm putting Peace in charge of your country and Righteousness as your leader. You won't hear about crime in your land anymore, no more robberies or vandalism. You'll name your main street 'Salvation Way' and have 'Praise Park' in the center of town. You won't need the sun during the day or the moon at night anymore. God will be your light forever, and your God will cover you in splendor. Your sun will never set, and your moon will never go away. I will be your eternal light. Your sad days are over. All your people will be living right, and they'll own the land forever. They're like a new plant that I planted with my own hands to show off my glory. The smallest family will become a huge clan, and the weakest person will become a strong nation. I am God. When the time is right, I'll make it happen, and it'll be fast.”

title: God's Epic Glow-Up Plan
paragraphs: The Spirit of God, the Master, is on me because God himself chose me. He sent me to tell the down-and-out the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, to announce freedom to everyone who feels trapped, and a clean slate for all prisoners. God sent me to announce the year of his grace—basically a huge party celebrating God taking down our enemies—and to comfort everyone who's mourning. He sent me to look after everyone who's sad in Zion, to give them flower crowns instead of ashes, happy vibes instead of sad news, and a spirit of praise instead of a feeling of giving up. They'll be called 'Oaks of Righteousness,' planted by God to show off his glory. They're going to rebuild the old ruins, and raise up a new city from the wreckage. They'll start over on the ruined cities, taking the rubble left behind and making it brand new. You'll hire outsiders to watch your flocks and foreigners to work your fields, but you'll get the title 'Priests of God,' and be honored as ministers of our God. You'll enjoy the best of what other nations have, and you'll be dripping in their glory. Because you got a double dose of trouble and way more than your fair share of hate, your inheritance in the land will be doubled and your joy will last forever.

'Because I, God, am all about fair play and I hate cheating and crime, I'll pay you what you're owed, on time and in full, and I'll make a forever promise with you. Your kids will be famous everywhere. Your children in other countries will be instantly recognized as the people I have blessed.'

I'm going to sing for joy in God, just explode with praise from the bottom of my soul! He dressed me up in a suit of salvation, and decked me out in a robe of righteousness, like a groom in a tux or a bride in her sparkly tiara. Because just like the earth bursts with spring wildflowers, and a garden is overflowing with blossoms, the Master, God, makes righteousness bloom and puts praise on display for all the nations to see.

title: Jerusalem's Epic Glow Up
paragraphs: When it comes to Zion, I just can't stay quiet. For Jerusalem, I'm not holding back until her goodness shines like the sun and her rescue is like a blazing torch. All the other nations will see how good you are, and their leaders will see your glory. You're gonna get a new name directly from God. You’ll be like a stunning crown in God’s hand, a jeweled cup held high by your God. Nobody's gonna call you 'Rejected' anymore, and your home won't be called 'Ruined' either. You'll be 'Hephzibah' (which means 'My Delight'), and your land will be 'Beulah' (meaning 'Married'). That's because God is super into you, and your land is gonna be like a huge wedding party. Just like a guy marries his girl, your creator is marrying you. And just like a groom is stoked about his bride, your God is so happy with you.

I've put guards on your walls, Jerusalem. They're on it 24/7, praying, shouting out, reminding God of his promises. They're not gonna give him a break until he does what he said he would, until he makes Jerusalem famous, like the 'City of Praise'.

God made a serious promise, and he's not backing down. He said, 'I'm never again gonna let your enemies raid your food storage and take your stuff. And foreigners won't be drinking the wine you worked so hard to make. Nope. The farmers who grow the food will get to eat it and thank God for it. And the winemakers will drink their wine in my holy places.'

Alright, head out the gates. Let's go! Get the road ready for everyone. Build the highway, get it done! Clear out all the junk, and raise a flag high so everyone can see it! And yeah, God has sent a message to the whole world: 'Tell Zion, 'Look! Your Savior is coming, and he's ready to do what he promised.' And Zion will get all new names: 'Holy People,' 'God's Redeemed,' 'Sought-After,' and 'City That's Not Abandoned.'

title: God's EPIC Comeback & The People Who Forgot
paragraphs: Someone asks, “Who’s that coming from Edom? From Bozrah, with clothes all dyed red? Who are you, robed in splendor, striding forward in all that power?” "It’s me. I announce victory, and I’m mighty to save."
"Okay, but why are your clothes so red? Like you’ve been treading a winepress or something?"

“I’ve been doing this all by myself. No one was there to back me up. I was so mad, I stomped on them like grapes; I was raging, I trampled them. Their blood went everywhere, my clothes are soaked. I was out for revenge. It was time to set things right. I looked for someone to help, but there was no one. I was appalled—not a single person stepped up. So I just did it myself, my anger was my fuel. I trampled people because I was so mad, crushed them in my rage, and their blood just soaked the ground.”

I’m gonna list out all the awesome things God has done, all the stuff He deserves praise for. All the crazy generous things God’s done, His major goodness to Israel—He showed so much compassion, His love was on another level. He was like, “For sure, these are my people, my kids who would never do me dirty.” So He became their Savior. In all their struggles, He was struggling too. He didn’t send some stranger to help them. He did it Himself, in person. Out of His own love and pity, He saved them. He rescued them and carried them for a super long time.
But then they switched up on Him; they made His Holy Spirit sad. So He turned on them, became their enemy, and fought them.

Then they started remembering the old days, back when Moses, God’s servant, was around: “Where’s the one who brought the shepherds of his flock up out of the sea? And what happened to the One who put His Holy Spirit in them? Who was right there with Moses, split the sea in front of them, and got famous forever for it, and led them through the deep, muddy water like it was nothing, like a horse on a flat road? Like a bunch of cows being led to a field, the Spirit of God gave them a break.”

That’s how you led your people! That’s how you got so famous! Look down from heaven, look at us! Look out the window of your holy and awesome house! What happened to your passion, your famous power moves, your deep pity, your compassion? Why you holding back? You’re our Father. Abraham and Israel are long gone. They wouldn’t even know who we are. But you’re our living Father, our Redeemer, famous since forever! Why, God, did you let us wander from your ways? Why did you make us so cold and stubborn that we stopped worshiping you like we should? Come back for us, your servants. You own us! We’re yours! For a little while your holy people were living good, but now our enemies have trashed your holy place. For a long time now, you’ve been ignoring us. It’s like you never even knew us.

title: God, Are You Gonna Leave Us on Read?
paragraphs: God, if you would just rip open the sky and come down, the mountains would totally shake. Like when a forest fire starts, or when water starts boiling like crazy. Your enemies would be shook and every country would be trembling. You've done some wild things we never saw coming, came down and made the mountains quake. Seriously, since the beginning of time, nobody has ever seen or heard of a God like you who shows up for those who wait for you. You connect with people who are actually happy to do the right thing and remember how you work. But you've been so mad at us. We messed up and just kept messing up for way too long. Is there even any hope for us? Can we be saved? We're all infected with sin, totally contaminated. Even our best tries are like dirty, greasy rags. We're like dried-up leaves in the fall, just blown away by the wind because of our sin. Nobody's even trying to pray to you or reach out, because you've turned your back on us and left us to deal with our own mess.

But still, God, you're our Father. We're the clay and you're the potter; you made all of us. Please don't be so mad at us, God. Don't keep a record of everything we've done wrong. Remember, we're your people—all of us. Your holy cities are like ghost towns now. Zion is a ghost town, and Jerusalem is just a field of weeds. Our holy and beautiful Temple, where our ancestors used to praise you, was burned to the ground. All our beautiful parks and gardens are ruined. After all this, are you just going to sit there and do nothing, God? Aren't you going to say something? Haven't you let us suffer long enough?

title: God's Epic Refresh: New Heaven, New Earth, No More Cringe
paragraphs: I’ve been making myself available to people who weren’t even asking, ready to be found by those who didn’t even look. I kept saying, ‘Here I am, right here!’ to a nation that was straight up ignoring me. I reached out day after day to a crew that turned their backs on me, people who were constantly making wrong turns and insisting on doing things their own way. They get on my last nerve, being rude to my face 24/7, inventing their own DIY, potluck-style religion. They hang out in tombs overnight trying to get messages from the dead, eat forbidden food, and drink some sketchy witch’s brew. Then they have the nerve to say, ‘Keep your distance. Don’t touch me. I’m holier than you.’ These people gag me. I can’t stand their stench. Look, I’ve got the receipts—their sins are all written down in front of me. I’m done with this. I’m going to pay them what they’ve earned for their sins. And for their parents’ sins lumped in? That’s a bonus,” says God. “Because they’ve been practicing their blasphemous worship, mocking me at their hillside shrines, I’m about to unleash the consequences and pay them back in full for their actions.

God’s Message: “But hold up, just because there are a few bad apples doesn’t mean the whole batch is ruined; there are still plenty of good ones left. So I’m going to protect those in Israel who actually listen to me. I’m not going to destroy the whole nation. I’ll bring out my true descendants from Jacob and the heirs of my mountains from Judah. My chosen ones will inherit the land, and my servants will move in. The awesome valley of Sharon in the west will be a pasture for their flocks, and the valley of Achor in the east will be a place for their herds to chill. This is for the people who actually bothered to reach out to me, who wanted me in their lives, and who made an effort to find me.

“But as for you who ghosted me, your God, who forgot about the holy mountains, who throw dinner parties for Lady Luck and host cocktail hours for Sir Fate… well, you asked for it. Your fate? It’s death. Because when I invited you, you ignored me; when I spoke, you brushed me off. You did the very things I said were evil and chose what I hate.”

Therefore, this is the Message from the Master, God: “My servants will eat, but you’ll be starving. My servants will drink, but you’ll be thirsty. My servants will be celebrating, while you’ll be hanging your heads in shame. My servants will laugh from pure joy, but you’ll be crying from a broken heart, wailing from a crushed spirit. Your name will become a curse word that my chosen people use. I, God, will put you to death and give my servants a new name. Then whoever gives a blessing in the land will do it in my faithful name, and whoever makes a promise will swear by my faithful name, because all the old troubles are gone and forgotten, totally out of my sight.

“Now, pay close attention: I’m creating a new heaven and a new earth. All the old troubles, chaos, and pain will be a thing of the past, completely forgotten. Look forward with joy. Get hyped for what I’m creating: I’m going to create Jerusalem to be pure joy and my people to be a total delight. I’ll find joy in Jerusalem and delight in my people. You won’t hear sounds of crying in the city anymore, no more cries of pain. No more babies dying young or old people not living a full life. Turning 100 will be the new normal—anything less will feel like you got cheated. People will build houses and actually live in them. They’ll plant fields and eat the food they grow. No more building a house just for someone else to take it over, no more planting fields for enemies to raid. My people will live as long as trees, and my chosen ones will get satisfaction from their work. They won’t work for nothing, and they won’t have their kids snatched away from them. They are a generation blessed by God, and their kids and grandkids are blessed too. Before they even call out to me, I’ll answer. While they’re still speaking, I’ll have already heard them. The wolf and the lamb will graze together, the lion and the ox will eat straw from the same trough, but snakes? They’ll be eating dirt. No one and nothing will hurt or destroy anyone on my holy mountain,” says God.

title: God's Final Mic Drop
paragraphs: God's message is this: "Heaven is my throne, and the whole earth is just my footstool. So what kind of house could you possibly build for me? What kind of vacation spot could you set aside for me? I made all of this! I own it all!" says God. "But here's what I'm actually looking for: someone who is humble and simple, who takes what I say seriously and respectfully.

"Your acts of 'worship' are actually just sinful. Killing an ox for a sacrifice is no different than murdering your neighbor. Your offerings are like dumping pig's blood on the altar. Your memorial gifts are like honoring a fake god. You choose to worship in a way that serves yourselves, and you love it—it's disgusting! So, I'm choosing to call out your nonsense and make your worst fears come true. Because when I invited you, you ghosted me. When I spoke, you ignored me. You did the very things I said were evil and chose what I hate."

But listen up, you who actually respect God's Word: "Your own families hate you and kick you out because of me. They make fun of you, saying, 'Let's see God's glory! If God is so great, why aren't you happy?' But they're the ones who are going to end up embarrassed."
There are loud rumbles from the city! A voice from the Temple! It's the voice of God, serving up judgment to his enemies:

"Before she even went into labor, she had the baby. Before the contractions hit, she delivered a son. Has anyone ever heard of something like that? Has anyone seen anything like it? A whole country born in a single day? A nation born in a flash? But Zion was barely in labor when she had her babies! Do I open the womb and then not deliver the baby? Do I, the one who delivers babies, close the womb?"

"So rejoice, Jerusalem, and everyone who loves her, celebrate! And all of you who have cried over her, come and join in the happy singing. You newborns can get your fill at her nurturing breasts. Yes, enjoy yourselves and drink as much as you want from her."

God's message: "I'm going to pour out well-being on her like a river, and the glory of nations like a flooding river. You'll nurse at her breasts, be held close in her arms, and bounced on her knees. I will comfort you like a mother comforts her child. You will be comforted in Jerusalem."

"You'll see all this and be so happy—you'll feel like you're on top of the world—as it becomes obvious that God is on your side and against his enemies. Because God is coming like a wildfire, and his chariots are like a tornado. He's bringing a furious outburst of anger, a fierce and fiery punishment. Because God is bringing judgment by fire, a death sentence for the human race. And many, so many, are under God's death sentence:
"All who enter the sacred groves for those secret, unholy rituals that end with a disgusting meal of pigs and mice will all eat together and then die together." This is God's decree.

"I know everything they've ever done or thought. I'm going to come and gather everyone—all nations, all languages. They'll come and see my glory. I'll set up a sign in the center of it all. I'll send the survivors of my judgment all over the world: to Spain and Africa, to Turkey and Greece, and to the faraway islands that have never even heard of me, who know nothing about what I've done or who I am. I'll send them out as missionaries to tell everyone about my glory. They'll bring back all your long-lost brothers and sisters from all over the world. They'll bring them on horses, in wagons and carts, on mules and camels, straight to my holy mountain in Jerusalem," says God. "They'll present them as a living act of worship to God, just like the Israelites present their offerings in a special container in the Temple of God. I'll even choose some of them to be priests and Levites," says God.

"Because just as the new heavens and the new earth that I'm making will last forever before me"—this is God's decree—"so will your children and your reputation last forever. Every month and every week, everyone will come to worship me," says God.

"And then they'll go out and see what happened to those who rebelled against me. Dead bodies! Maggots will be eating them endlessly, and they'll be fuel for fires that never go out. Everyone who sees it and smells the stench will be sick to their stomach."
